title: Provision of Borewell at Manappad Point Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate contract) for providing a borewell at Manappad Point Lighthouse, Thoothukudi District, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Manappad Point Lighthouse, Thoothukudi District, Tamilnadu

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Tender fee NIL. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity printed as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL etc or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only completed works with completion certificate; value updated at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: provision of borewell / repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2024
Key technical personnel available for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Undertaking that tender is unconditional (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not blacklisted
List of gazetted and non-gazetted relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL
Self-certification under preference to Make in India order (Annexure VI)
notes: Scanned Section I NIT only; no BOQ or borewell specifications. Bid download/submission 05.12.2024 10:00 to 26.12.2024 15:00; EMD up to 26.12.2024 15:00; opening 27.12.2024 15:00. Spelled 'Manappad'; station list 'Manapad Point'.
